name: Cheesy BBQ Chicken Wrap with Cabbage, Carrot & Apple Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with water by 1 inch.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt

instructions.primary_message: Set chicken over high heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer until cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and let cool, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head napa cabbage
2 medium carrots
2 Granny Smith apples

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
apple cider vinegar
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apples. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Place ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup ketchup
apple cider vinegar
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp chili powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl with the sauce.
When the chicken is cool, use two forks to shred it into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the cheesy chicken filling.
Place tortillas on a flat surface, then divide cheesy chicken filling and a small portion of slaw between them. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining slaw for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!
